C0983.title: Game for Peace Spectator Wallhack Crackdown Announcement
C0983.summary: On April 22, 2020, the Game for Peace security operations team announced that some players were using low-ranked alternate accounts with wallhack tools to spectate high-ranked main accounts for cheating.
